products.title: Ribbed Fleece Vest - Mulberry
products.body_html:
The ultimate layering piece for Fall ball and casual wear. The ribbed natural fiber blend gives this piece a soft hand feel and allows for a wide range of temperature regulation. Hidden left chest and hip pockets allow for a streamlined look while still having room for your phone, puck of pouches, or the handful of extra tees you grabbed at the turn. 

Details

  • Unique ottoman fabric
  • 35% Cotton, 35% Modal, 30% Recycled Polyester
  • Micro suede interior collar and sleeve openings 
  • Custom double J hook brass zipper pull
  • Hidden left-chest and waist pockets
  • Double J hook logo embroidered on the rear collar

Fit

  • Athletic fit, but not slim. Ample room to layer a polo or pullover underneath. 
  • Natural fiber blended with recycled poly allows for full range of movement.

  • Double J Hook embroidered on left hip
  • Custom branded collar piping

Fit

Save $23 when you bundle a pair of shorts and a polo.

products.title: Legacy Shoe Bag
products.body_html:
Italian pebbled leather just sounds sexy...and it is.

Crafted with full-grain leather, this shoe bag is durable, breathable and polished. Pull down the double J hook brass zipper to reveal an elegant and functional navy splash liner, along with a customizable branded leather tag. 

Transport your golf spikes or dress shoes to and from the course in style. Guaranteed to turn heads in the locker room while maintaining an understated, classic look. 

To have your initials, club, or company logo debossed on the interior tag, please contact us. (12 unit minimum)

products.title: Juniper & James x Zilker Leather Belt - Navy
products.body_html:
The green version of this belt was so popular that we brought it back in Navy. 

Made with super premium raw Argentine saddle leather and artful nylon thread, this belt is handmade with care in Buenos Aires. 

Please note: leather varies from belt to belt due to the uniqueness of each hide and the traditional artisan process of sun-tanning raw leather. The leather will patina over time into a darker, honey brown color. 

Sizing: a good rule when choosing your size is to go 2'' larger than your waist size. So if you typically wear a size 32 shorts/pants, order a size 34 belt. For odd sizes, we suggest ordering 3'' larger, for example: if you are a 33'' waist, choose a size 36 belt.

products.title: Juniper & James Logo Tee
products.body_html:
Our full logo, including our Great Blue Heron spirit animal. J&J is a southern golfer's brand - one that truly understands the outdoorsman with a golf problem. 

Snag this super soft and comfortable tee + rock it proudly. 

Athletic fit. 60% Cotton, 40% Polyester.

products.title: Redfish Tail Tee
products.body_html:
What makes you lick your chops more: a 7 foot birdie putt or a tailing redfish? Yes, and yes.

We designed this tee for all of you saltwater fishermen who also love to slap the white ball around. At the end of the day, our brand is all about playing good golf and getting outside to enjoy nature. 

Athletic fit. 60% Cotton, 40% Polyester.

products.title: Marsh Scene Tee
products.body_html:
There is a lot of activity in the marsh. The flora and fauna mingle creating a beautiful scene. We designed this tee because we can't think of a much better day than playing a round of golf and catching a redfish. 

Athletic fit. 60% Cotton, 40% Polyester

products.title: Heron Tee
products.body_html:
The Great Blue Heron is the guardian of the marsh. It moves fluidly, with intent and purpose. It has a laid back demeanor but can pull out the dagger when needed - kind of like that sneaky good golfer in your foursome after he declares a "hammer back."

Rock this comfortable tee to bring out your inner heron. 

Athletic fit. 60% Cotton, 40% Polyester.

products.title: Golf Shorts - Driftwood
products.body_html:
Discover the Best Golf Shorts

The best golf shorts are the ones you don’t have to think about. They look sharp, fit well, feel comfortable, and let you focus on your game.

  • 4-way stretch 
  • Ultra breathable and lightweight 
  • UPF50+ sun protection

Sizing: 

Our shorts have a 7 and 9" inseams in a 4-way stretch nylon fabric with a comfort waistband and great fit. The waist size can run slightly large due to the flexibility of the fabric. If you are in between sizes, we recommend sizing down. For example: a size 33 waist should size down to size 32. Otherwise, your usual even waist size should fit great.
